bosses.name: Priestess (Arcana Boss)
bosses.strategy: The Priestess Shadow is on a runaway monorail with a strict 30-minute timer. She frequently casts Bufu/Mabufu and summons Tiara Shadows. Focus fire on the boss using physical attacks (Cleave, Bash) and Agi from Junpei or fire-capable Personas. Keep Yukari on heal duty with Dia.
bosses.buildPrep: Equip Personas resistant to Ice (e.g., Apsaras, Forneus) and avoid bringing Personas weak to Ice (like Hermit/Pixie). Bring Medicine and Soul Drops.

bosses.name: Empress & Emperor (Arcana Bosses)
bosses.weaknesses: Empress: Slash/Strike/Pierce | Emperor: Fire/Ice/Elec/Wind (Alternates via Paradigm Shift)
bosses.resistances: Empress: Null Magic | Emperor: Null Physical
bosses.strategy: Empress uses Paradigm Shift to alter her elemental weaknesses, while Emperor resists all physical moves. Use Akihiko's Zio, Junpei's Agi, and Protagonist's elemental arsenal on Emperor, while hitting Empress with physical attacks like Cleave or Sonic Punch. When Paradigm Shift triggers, scan immediately to identify the new weakness.
bosses.buildPrep: Have a versatile Persona roster covering all four main elements (Agi, Bufu, Zio, Garu) plus physical strikes. Oberon, Gurr, and Archangel work wonders.

bosses.name: Hierophant (Arcana Boss)
bosses.strategy: Hierophant spams Sukukaja, Zionga/Mazionga, and Prophecy of Ruin (which inflicts Fear). Equip Fear-preventing accessories or have Patra/Energy Drop ready. Dispel his buffs with Dekaja if available, debuff his attack with Tarunda (Akihiko), and pound him with heavy physical skills or Fire/Wind magic.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas immune or resistant to Electricity and Fear (e.g., Take-Mikazuchi, High Pixie). Stock up on Me Patra Gems and Dis-Fear items.

bosses.name: Lovers (Arcana Boss)
bosses.location: Hotel Shirakawa (7/7 Full Moon - Mirror Room)
bosses.strategy: Lovers relies heavily on Marin Karin and Holy Arrow to Charm your party members. A charmed party member will heal the boss or kill allies. Immediately cure Charm with Dis-Charm or Charmdi. Use multi-target buffing and heavy physical/elemental attacks to quickly drain its HP pool.
bosses.buildPrep: Narcissus Flower accessory (nullifies Charm) or Narcissus persona. Buy at least 10 Dis-Charm items from Aohige Pharmacy before the full moon.

bosses.name: Chariot & Justice (Arcana Bosses)
bosses.weaknesses: Chariot: None | Justice: None (Weakness shifts when separated)
bosses.strategy: The battle starts with them unified as a tank. When they split into Chariot (Physical focus) and Justice (Magic/Status focus), you MUST defeat both in the same round or the survivor will resurrect the other with half HP! Balance damage between both targets before finishing them off with an All-Out Attack or multi-target skill.
bosses.buildPrep: Equip Personas with multi-target skills like Maragion, Mabufula, or Bladefist. Bring Matarukaja and Marakukaja.

bosses.name: Hermit (Arcana Boss)
bosses.strategy: Hermit charges electricity with Giga Spark, dealing immense damage next turn. When he starts charging, have the entire party Guard immediately. Use physical powerhouses like Shinjiro (Fatal End) and Akihiko's debuffs (Tarunda, Rakunda) to tear through his defense.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Elec resistance or null (Thoth, Dionysus, Thor). Stock up on Bead Chains and Revivalls.

bosses.name: Fortune & Strength (Arcana Bosses)
bosses.resistances: Fortune: Null All Magic | Strength: Null Physical
bosses.strategy: Fortune spins the Wheel of Fortune roulette determining buffs, damage, or status for either player or boss. Time the roulette needle when it's over the blue (player) quadrant! Strength protects Fortune and attacks with devastating physical strikes. Have magical attackers focus on Strength, and physical attackers focus on Fortune.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with high Agility and Enduring Soul. Bring Mediarama and Dekunda.

bosses.name: Hanged Man & Devious/Dependent Maya
bosses.resistances: Hanged Man: Null All Ailments, Null Light/Dark
bosses.strategy: Hanged Man floats in the air protected by Mayas. You cannot damage Hanged Man until you destroy all 3 Mayas supporting him, causing him to fall. Once grounded, unload your most powerful single-target attacks (God's Hand, Agidyne, Bufudyne). Watch out for Armed Leviathan explosive summons.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Maragidyne or powerful fire magic to obliterate Mayas quickly. Bring Homunculus items to protect against instant-kill dark skills.

bosses.name: Takaya & Jin (Tartarus 254F / End)
bosses.resistances: Takaya: Light (Repel), Dark (Repel) | Jin: Fire (Repel), Dark (Null)
bosses.strategy: Jin acts as the support specialist throwing Flash Bombs, elemental items, and buffs, while Takaya casts Megidolaon and severe elemental magic. Focus down Jin first with ice, wind, or physical attacks to stop his disruptive ailments, then debuff Takaya and burst him down.
bosses.buildPrep: High level Personas with Dekaja, Dekunda, and Mediarahan (Surt, Odin, Cybele, Helel).

bosses.name: Jin (Solo Battle)
bosses.strategy: Jin uses all tier-3 elemental spells, throws grenades that inflict Confusion and Poison, and uses Dekaja/Dekunda. Keep your party healed with Mediarahan, use Rakunda to lower his defense, and strike with physical skills like Primal Force or Pulinpa combos.
bosses.buildPrep: Equip Null Charm/Confusion gear or bring Amrita Sodas. Personas with Repel/Drain Fire (Surt, Cerberus).

bosses.name: Takaya (Solo Battle)
bosses.strategy: Takaya opens with Megidolaon and severe Almighty spells, followed by Mind Charge + elemental dynes. Keep Tarunda and Marakukaja active at all times. Use physical crit builds (Apocalyptic Guide, High Counter) or severe Almighty spells (Morning Star, Black Viper).
bosses.buildPrep: Messiah, Satan, Helel, or Lucifer with Spell Master, Mind Charge, and Almighty Boost.

bosses.name: Nyx Avatar (Final Boss - 14 Arcana Phases)
bosses.weaknesses: Fool to Hanged Man: Shifts every phase | Death Phase: None
bosses.resistances: Death Phase: Null Light/Dark, High Defense
bosses.strategy: Nyx Avatar cycles through 14 distinct phases representing the Major Arcana, each with different weaknesses and affinities. During the final Death phase, Nyx casts 'Moonless Gown' which REPELLS ALL ATTACKS; you MUST pass/heal during Moonless Gown or you will wipe! When Moonless Gown fades, buff up and unleash your strongest skills while watching out for 'Night Queen' (severe Almighty + random ailments).
bosses.buildPrep: Armageddon fusion spell (Helel + Satan) for instant victory in Death phase or Messiah / Lucifer with Salvation, Debilitate, Heat Riser, and Unshaken Will.

bosses.name: Venus Eagle x3
bosses.strategy: Use Yukari's bow attack or Protagonist's bow/pierce personas to knock down each Venus Eagle, followed by an All-Out Attack. They cast Garu, so avoid having Personas weak to Wind equipped on the protagonist.
bosses.buildPrep: Equip Orpheus or Apsaras. Stock 2-3 Medicines.

bosses.name: Dancing Hand x3
bosses.strategy: The Dancing Hands use various elemental spells. Strike them with Junpei's Bash or Protagonist's Strike skills to knock them down for All-Out Attacks.
bosses.buildPrep: Persona with Bash or Sonic Punch (Forneus, Ara Mitama).

bosses.name: Rampaging Drive
bosses.strategy: Rampaging Drive deals heavy physical strike damage and uses Tarukaja to buff attack. Use Tarunda to lower its attack power, keep Yukari on continuous healing, and hit it with Zio or magic spells.
bosses.buildPrep: Equip Pixie (Zio) or Chimera. High physical defense armor.

bosses.name: Crying Table
bosses.strategy: Spams Agilao and Maragi. Exploit its Ice weakness using Bufu from Protagonist or Apsaras. Once knocked down, unleash All-Out Attacks and avoid using Junpei's Fire skills.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Bufu (Apsaras, Forneus, Jack Frost). Avoid Personas weak to Fire.

bosses.name: Change Relic

bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Wind resistance (Gurr, Archangel) and Dis-Poison items.

bosses.strategy: Use Akihiko's Mazio/Zio and Protagonist's Zio to knock all three beetles down, triggering an All-Out Attack every round.
bosses.buildPrep: Oberon or Take-Mikazuchi with Mazio and Elec Boost.

bosses.buildPrep: Cu Chulainn, Thor, or Siegfried with Pierce Boost and Apt Pupil.

bosses.location: Hotel Shirakawa (7/7 Full Moon - Mirror Room)
bosses.strategy: Lovers relies heavily on Marin Karin and Holy Arrow to Charm your party members. A charmed party member will heal the boss or kill allies. Immediately cure Charm with Dis-Charm or Charmdi. Use multi-target buffing and heavy physical/elemental attacks to quickly drain its HP pool.
bosses.buildPrep: Narcissus Flower accessory (nullifies Charm) or Narcissus persona. Buy at least 10 Dis-Charm items from Aohige Pharmacy before the full moon.

bosses.name: Chariot & Justice (Arcana Bosses)
bosses.weaknesses: Chariot: None | Justice: None (Weakness shifts when separated)
bosses.strategy: The battle starts with them unified as a tank. When they split into Chariot (Physical focus) and Justice (Magic/Status focus), you MUST defeat both in the same round or the survivor will resurrect the other with half HP! Balance damage between both targets before finishing them off with an All-Out Attack or multi-target skill.
bosses.buildPrep: Equip Personas with multi-target skills like Maragion, Mabufula, or Bladefist. Bring Matarukaja and Marakukaja.

bosses.name: Hermit (Arcana Boss)
bosses.strategy: Hermit charges electricity with Giga Spark, dealing immense damage next turn. When he starts charging, have the entire party Guard immediately. Use physical powerhouses like Shinjiro (Fatal End) and Akihiko's debuffs (Tarunda, Rakunda) to tear through his defense.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Elec resistance or null (Thoth, Dionysus, Thor). Stock up on Bead Chains and Revivalls.

bosses.name: Fortune & Strength (Arcana Bosses)
bosses.resistances: Fortune: Null All Magic | Strength: Null Physical
bosses.strategy: Fortune spins the Wheel of Fortune roulette determining buffs, damage, or status for either player or boss. Time the roulette needle when it's over the blue (player) quadrant! Strength protects Fortune and attacks with devastating physical strikes. Have magical attackers focus on Strength, and physical attackers focus on Fortune.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with high Agility and Enduring Soul. Bring Mediarama and Dekunda.

bosses.name: Hanged Man & Devious/Dependent Maya
bosses.resistances: Hanged Man: Null All Ailments, Null Light/Dark
bosses.strategy: Hanged Man floats in the air protected by Mayas. You cannot damage Hanged Man until you destroy all 3 Mayas supporting him, causing him to fall. Once grounded, unload your most powerful single-target attacks (God's Hand, Agidyne, Bufudyne). Watch out for Armed Leviathan explosive summons.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Maragidyne or powerful fire magic to obliterate Mayas quickly. Bring Homunculus items to protect against instant-kill dark skills.

bosses.name: Takaya & Jin (Tartarus 254F / End)
bosses.resistances: Takaya: Light (Repel), Dark (Repel) | Jin: Fire (Repel), Dark (Null)
bosses.strategy: Jin acts as the support specialist throwing Flash Bombs, elemental items, and buffs, while Takaya casts Megidolaon and severe elemental magic. Focus down Jin first with ice, wind, or physical attacks to stop his disruptive ailments, then debuff Takaya and burst him down.
bosses.buildPrep: High level Personas with Dekaja, Dekunda, and Mediarahan (Surt, Odin, Cybele, Helel).

bosses.name: Jin (Solo Battle)
bosses.strategy: Jin uses all tier-3 elemental spells, throws grenades that inflict Confusion and Poison, and uses Dekaja/Dekunda. Keep your party healed with Mediarahan, use Rakunda to lower his defense, and strike with physical skills like Primal Force or Pulinpa combos.
bosses.buildPrep: Equip Null Charm/Confusion gear or bring Amrita Sodas. Personas with Repel/Drain Fire (Surt, Cerberus).

bosses.name: Takaya (Solo Battle)
bosses.strategy: Takaya opens with Megidolaon and severe Almighty spells, followed by Mind Charge + elemental dynes. Keep Tarunda and Marakukaja active at all times. Use physical crit builds (Apocalyptic Guide, High Counter) or severe Almighty spells (Morning Star, Black Viper).
bosses.buildPrep: Messiah, Satan, Helel, or Lucifer with Spell Master, Mind Charge, and Almighty Boost.

bosses.name: Nyx Avatar (Final Boss - 14 Arcana Phases)
bosses.weaknesses: Fool to Hanged Man: Shifts every phase | Death Phase: None
bosses.resistances: Death Phase: Null Light/Dark, High Defense
bosses.strategy: Nyx Avatar cycles through 14 distinct phases representing the Major Arcana, each with different weaknesses and affinities. During the final Death phase, Nyx casts 'Moonless Gown' which REPELLS ALL ATTACKS; you MUST pass/heal during Moonless Gown or you will wipe! When Moonless Gown fades, buff up and unleash your strongest skills while watching out for 'Night Queen' (severe Almighty + random ailments).
bosses.buildPrep: Armageddon fusion spell (Helel + Satan) for instant victory in Death phase or Messiah / Lucifer with Salvation, Debilitate, Heat Riser, and Unshaken Will.

bosses.name: Venus Eagle x3
bosses.strategy: Use Yukari's bow attack or Protagonist's bow/pierce personas to knock down each Venus Eagle, followed by an All-Out Attack. They cast Garu, so avoid having Personas weak to Wind equipped on the protagonist.
bosses.buildPrep: Equip Orpheus or Apsaras. Stock 2-3 Medicines.

bosses.name: Dancing Hand x3
bosses.strategy: The Dancing Hands use various elemental spells. Strike them with Junpei's Bash or Protagonist's Strike skills to knock them down for All-Out Attacks.
bosses.buildPrep: Persona with Bash or Sonic Punch (Forneus, Ara Mitama).

bosses.name: Rampaging Drive
bosses.strategy: Rampaging Drive deals heavy physical strike damage and uses Tarukaja to buff attack. Use Tarunda to lower its attack power, keep Yukari on continuous healing, and hit it with Zio or magic spells.
bosses.buildPrep: Equip Pixie (Zio) or Chimera. High physical defense armor.

bosses.name: Crying Table
bosses.strategy: Spams Agilao and Maragi. Exploit its Ice weakness using Bufu from Protagonist or Apsaras. Once knocked down, unleash All-Out Attacks and avoid using Junpei's Fire skills.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Bufu (Apsaras, Forneus, Jack Frost). Avoid Personas weak to Fire.

bosses.name: Change Relic
bosses.strategy: Change Relic uses Magarula and Poisma. Have Akihiko debuff its attack with Tarunda and hit it with Zio or heavy physical attacks. Keep party health topped up to survive Magarula.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Wind resistance (Gurr, Archangel) and Dis-Poison items.

bosses.name: Golden Beetle x3
bosses.strategy: Use Akihiko's Mazio/Zio and Protagonist's Zio to knock all three beetles down, triggering an All-Out Attack every round.
bosses.buildPrep: Oberon or Take-Mikazuchi with Mazio and Elec Boost.

bosses.name: Intrepid Knight
bosses.strategy: Intrepid Knight casts Magarula and Mind Charge. Have Yukari defend or equip Wind-resistant gear. Attack with Zio or heavy Strike skills.
bosses.buildPrep: Fortuna or Archangel with Garu resistance.

bosses.name: Furious Gigas
bosses.strategy: Furious Gigas relies on High Counter and Power Charge + Gigantic Fist. DO NOT use physical attacks! Spam Bufudyne/Bufula with Mitsuru and Zio with Akihiko.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with high magic stats and Tarunda/Rakunda (Pale Rider, Lamia, King Frost).

bosses.name: Fanatic Tower
bosses.strategy: Fanatic Tower repels 3 elemental types and uses Poison Mist + Zionga. Only use Wind (Garu) or physical attacks like Slash/Pierce.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Garula (Kusi Mitama, Saki Mitama) and Dis-Poison.

bosses.name: Magical Magus x3
bosses.strategy: All three cast Mabufula and Spirit Drain. Exploit their Fire weakness using Maragion or Agilao to knock them down for immediate All-Out Attacks.
bosses.buildPrep: Surt, Hua Po, or Pyro Jack with Maragion and Fire Boost.

bosses.name: Natural Dancer
bosses.strategy: Spams Tentarafoo (Panic/Confusion) and Magarula. If party members are panicked, they drop cash and waste turns. Equip Narcissus Flower or Me Patra items and hit with heavy physicals.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Me Patra, Mediarama, and Garu null.

bosses.name: Sleeping Table
bosses.strategy: One of the most infamous Tartarus gatekeepers! Spams Megidola (severe almighty), Maragidyne, and Ghastly Wail (instantly kills feared allies). You MUST keep Mediarama/Mediarahan flowing, maintain Tarunda on the boss, and cure Fear immediately.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Null Fire and High Endurance (Thor, Surt, Titania). Equip Null Fear accessories on all party members.

bosses.name: Reckless Zephyr
bosses.strategy: Uses Garudyne, Magarudyne, and Old One (Brainwash/Charm). Lower its attack and defense and hit with Pierce skills or Bufudyne.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Garu Null/Repel (Jatayu, Quetzalcoatl).

bosses.name: Jotun of Grief
bosses.strategy: Jotun of Grief drains all elemental spells! You MUST use Pierce attacks (Primal Force, Pulinpa, Arrow Rain) or Almighty spells. Have Aigis use Pierce physicals while Protagonist buffs.
bosses.buildPrep: Cu Chulainn, Thor, or Siegfried with Pierce Boost and Apt Pupil.

bosses.name: Stasis Giant x3
bosses.strategy: All three cast heavy physical skills and power charges. Knock them down with Maragidyne from Protagonist and wipe them with All-Out Attacks.
bosses.buildPrep: Surt with Maragidyne and Fire Amp.

bosses.name: The Reaper (Death)
bosses.location: Tartarus (Any floor after lingering for 5+ minutes)
bosses.strategy: The Reaper casts all -dyne tier spells, Megidolaon, Concentrate, and instant-kill Hama/Mudo spells. Keep Debilitate and Heat Riser up, maintain shields with Magic Mirror / Tetrakarn, and blast with severe Almighty or High Crit physical builds.
bosses.buildPrep: Armageddon Fusion Spell (instant 9,999 damage) or Helel / Satan / Lucifer with Spell Master, Mind Charge, and Victory Cry.

bosses.name: Elizabeth (Ultimate Superboss)
bosses.party: Protagonist Solo ONLY (No Party Members Allowed!)
bosses.resistances: Nulls/Repels all elements if you break her rules
bosses.strategy: Rules of Engagement: 1) SOLO ONLY. 2) DO NOT EQUIP PERSONAS WITH NULL/REPEL/DRAIN against her current elemental phase or she will cast 99,999 Megidolaon! 3) Keep exact track of her 8-turn element cycle (Surt -> Jack Frost -> Thor -> Cu Chulainn -> Metatron -> Alice -> Nebiros -> Masakado). 4) When her HP drops below 10,000, cast Armageddon immediately before she heals to full with Diarahan and Megidolaons you!
bosses.buildPrep: Orpheus Telos with Resist All, High Counter, Mind Charge, Spell Master, Unshaken Will, and Salvation. Enduring Soul (survives one 99,999 Megidolaon). Armageddon Fusion Spell.

bosses.name: Theodore (Ultimate Superboss - FeMC)
bosses.resistances: Follows same strict battle mechanics as Elizabeth
bosses.strategy: Follows the exact same 8-turn Persona cycle as Elizabeth. Must fight alone without Null/Repel/Drain passives that trigger his instant 99,999 Megidolaon. Count HP carefully and execute Armageddon when he falls under 10,000 HP.
bosses.buildPrep: Orpheus Telos with High Counter, Salvation, Mind Charge, Enduring Soul, and Armageddon.

bosses.name: Margaret (Vision Quest Ultimate Battle)
bosses.strategy: Margaret attacks twice per turn with severe magic, Dragon Hustle buffs, and Power Charged God's Hand. Keep party fully buffed with Matarukaja/Marakukaja and keep Debilitate on Margaret. Have Yukari cast Mediarahan every single round.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Unshaken Will, Spell Master, Salvation, and severe physical/almighty skills.

bosses.name: Yosuke's Shadow
bosses.strategy: The tutorial boss fight of the game. Yosuke's Shadow uses Power Charge followed by Wind of Vanity and physical attacks. Hit him with Izanagi's Zio to knock him down and gain '1 More'. Guard immediately on the turn after he uses Power Charge to block his amplified attack.
bosses.buildPrep: Izanagi equipped with Zio. Keep Medicine on hand to heal if your HP drops below half.

bosses.name: Chie's Shadow
bosses.strategy: Chie's Shadow uses Mabsent Mind to cause dizziness and targets Yosuke with Green Wall and Bufu (which hits Yosuke's weakness!). Use Yosuke's Garu to knock her down and trigger All-Out Attacks. When she uses 'Bottomless Gaze' (locking onto Yosuke), have Yosuke Guard to prevent her from exploiting his Ice weakness.
bosses.buildPrep: Persona with Garu or physical skills. Yosuke equipped with Garu. Stock 4-5 Medicines.

bosses.name: Avenger Knight (Mini-Boss)
bosses.strategy: Avenger Knight buffs himself with Power Charge and delivers heavy physical strikes. He is weak to Fire; however, avoid using Chie's physical attacks as he resists them. Use Fire spells or items to knock him down for All-Out Attacks.
bosses.buildPrep: Persona with Agi (Senri, Orobas). Chie and Yosuke on support/healing duty.

bosses.name: Yukiko's Shadow
bosses.strategy: Yukiko's Shadow casts Burn to Ash (heavy fire damage) and White Wall (boosts ice defense). When she summons the 'Charming Prince', focus fire on the Prince immediately because he heals her with Dia and casts White Wall. When she uses 'Shivering Glance' (locking onto Chie), HAVE CHIE GUARD IMMEDIATELY to prevent her from being knocked down by Agilao.
bosses.buildPrep: Fusing Senri (Null Fire) is the MVP strategy for Yu, making you immune to Burn to Ash. Chie equipped with Bufu/Mabufu. Stock 5+ Ice Cubes or Revival Beads.

bosses.name: Contrarian King (Optional Dungeon Boss)
bosses.strategy: One of the most dangerous optional bosses in the early game! He opens with Rampage (dealing devastating physical strike damage that can wipe a party under level 30). You MUST cast Tarunda to lower his attack, Marakukaja to boost party defense, and have party members Guard if their HP is below 70%. Deal damage using Elec (Zio) or Ice (Bufu).
bosses.buildPrep: Recommended Level 32-35+. Personas with high Endurance and Physical Resist (Eligor, Rakshasa). Equip Red Wall on Chie.

bosses.name: Daring Gigas (Mini-Boss)
bosses.strategy: Spams Power Charge, Tarukaja, and Single Shot. Have Yukiko or Yu lower his attack with Tarunda. Guard on the turn after Power Charge to absorb his huge strike.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Tarunda, Media, and Physical resistance (Archangel, Ares).

bosses.name: Shadow Kanji, Nice Guy & Tough Guy
bosses.weaknesses: Nice Guy: Ice (Weak), Fire (Weak) | Tough Guy: Fire (Weak) | Shadow Kanji: None
bosses.strategy: Kill Order: 1) NICE GUY FIRST (He casts Heat Riser, Diarama, and Tetrakarn on Shadow Kanji). 2) TOUGH GUY SECOND (Uses Rampage and Sonic Punch). 3) SHADOW KANJI LAST. When Shadow Kanji casts 'Forbidden Murmur' (inflicts Poison on males) or 'Roar of Wrath' (inflicts Rage on females), cure ailments immediately. When he uses 'Fanatical Spark' (charges electricity), have Yosuke Guard to protect his Elec weakness.
bosses.buildPrep: Persona with Bufu/Agi (Jack Frost, Hua Po, King Frost). Dokudami Tea / Dis-Poison items. Keep Yukiko on constant Mediarama healing.

bosses.name: Intolerant Officer (Optional Dungeon Boss)
bosses.strategy: Summons backup and uses Poison Mist + Vicious Strike. Exploit its Elec weakness using Kanji or Yu's Zio to keep him pinned down.
bosses.buildPrep: Persona with Zionga/Mazionga and Elec Boost (Take-Mikazuchi, Thoth).

bosses.name: Amorous Snake (Mini-Boss)
bosses.strategy: Uses Stagnant Air, Poison Mist, and Virus Wave. Hit her with Yukiko's Agilao or Yu's Fire spells to trigger All-Out Attacks.
bosses.buildPrep: Dis-Poison and Persona with Fire skills (Hua Po, Pyro Jack).

bosses.name: Rise's Shadow
bosses.resistances: Shifts affinities each turn via Analysis
bosses.strategy: Phase 1: Rise attacks with all four elemental spells. When her HP reaches 50%, she uses 'Supreme Analysis' making all attacks miss. Simply GUARD FOR 3 TURNS until the cutscene triggers; this ends the fight and transitions into Shadow Teddie!
bosses.buildPrep: Personas covering multiple elements without severe weaknesses. Keep Mediarama ready.

bosses.name: Shadow Teddie
bosses.strategy: Shadow Teddie attacks twice per turn and casts Mind Charge, Mabufula, and Heat Wave. Watch out for two key telegraphs: 1) 'Ultra Charge' (charges glowing orb): You have 1 turn to hit him, then EVERY PARTY MEMBER MUST GUARD on the next turn to survive 'Nihil Hand' (massive Almighty damage). 2) 'Nullity Curl' (inflicts Dizzy on entire party): Immediately cure dizzy allies before Nihil Hand hits.
bosses.buildPrep: Fusing Dis or King Frost with Media and Energy Drop. Keep Yukiko on constant heal duty and Kanji for physical burst.

bosses.name: Momentary Child (Optional Dungeon Boss)
bosses.strategy: Uses Rampage, Deathbound, and Tarukaja. Hit with Ice spells (Bufudyne) to knock down and execute All-Out Attacks.
bosses.buildPrep: Persona with Bufudyne / Ice Amp (King Frost, Ganga).

bosses.name: Killing Hand (Mini-Boss)
bosses.strategy: Summons Almighty Hands. Focus fire on the Killing Hand first to stop it from repeatedly summoning reinforcements.
bosses.buildPrep: Persona with Deathbound or multi-target elemental spells.

bosses.name: Shadow Mitsuo / Mitsuo the Hero
bosses.strategy: Two-Phase Boss Fight: 1) 'Mitsuo the Hero' (8-bit outer shell): Attack with heavy physicals and magic. When the shell breaks, Shadow Mitsuo is exposed. 2) 'Shadow Mitsuo' Core: Unload your highest damage skills (Black Frost's Mind Charge + Agidyne, Kanji's Fatal End) while he is knocked down. When he starts chanting to rebuild the shell ('Whisper' -> 'Chant' -> 'Prayer'), deal enough damage to interrupt the chant and stun him again! Beware: When he inflicts Fear, CURE IT IMMEDIATELY or he will cast 'Ghastly Wail' for an instant wipe!
bosses.buildPrep: MVP Persona: Black Frost (has Mind Charge, Agidyne, Fire Amp, and no elemental weaknesses). Stock 10+ Sedative / Dis-Fear items. Keep Mediarama active every turn.

bosses.name: Escapist Soldier (Optional Dungeon Boss)
bosses.strategy: Uses Mudoon and heavy strike skills with High Counter. DO NOT use physical attacks! Spam Garudyne / Magarula with Yosuke to knock him down.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Garudyne and Wind Amp (Garuda, Kurama Tengu).

bosses.name: Dominating Machine (Optional Dungeon Boss)
bosses.strategy: Spams Power Charge + God's Hand and Gigantic Fist. Keep Tarunda and Marakukaja active and blast with severe elemental magic.
bosses.buildPrep: Trumpeter or Black Frost with Rakunda, Tarunda, and Ziodyne.

bosses.name: Shadow Naoto
bosses.strategy: Shadow Naoto casts 'Element Zero' (removes all party elemental resistances), followed by single-target -dyne spells targeting weaknesses. She uses 'Mute Ray' (inflicts Silence) and 'Galgalim Eyes' (reduces a party member's HP to 1 and inflicts Enervation!). When Galgalim Eyes lands, immediately heal the afflicted party member with Diarahan/Medicine. Buff party defense and hit with heavy physical or almighty spells.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Mediarahan, Energy Shower, and Amrita Soda items. High physical attackers like Kanji (Primal Force).

bosses.name: Kunino-Sagiri
bosses.strategy: 1) Quad Converge: Amplifies ONE element by 300% and reduces all other damage to single digits. Identify the boosted element (by watching which spell he casts) and hit him with that exact element! 2) Control Mechanism: At 50% HP, he MIND CONTROLS 1 to 3 of your party members to fight for him! DO NOT ATTACK YOUR ALLIES; simply have Yu GUARD and cast Mediarahan until the mind control wears off after 3 turns. 3) Usubeni no Mai: Deals heavy Almighty damage, guard when his HP is low.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with all 4 high-tier elements (Ziodyne, Agidyne, Garudyne, Bufudyne), Mediarahan, and Debilitate (Trumpeter).

bosses.name: Taro Namatame
bosses.resistances: Shifts affinities based on active avatars
bosses.strategy: Namatame manifests avatars of light and darkness. Use Rakunda on him and cycle between physical and magic damage. Keep party HP above 80% to avoid sudden burst downs.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Mediarahan, Matarukaja, and Marakukaja.

bosses.name: Tohru Adachi
bosses.strategy: Adachi uses Evil Smile (Fear) -> Ghastly Wail (Instant Death combo), Heat Riser, Ziodyne, and Mudoon. Keep Dekaja ready to immediately strip his Heat Riser buffs! Equip Null Fear accessories on your party. Use Debilitate on Adachi and blast him with Hassou Tobi or severe spells. When Adachi's HP drops to 0, the battle immediately transitions into Ameno-sagiri with NO rest!
bosses.buildPrep: Trumpeter with Debilitate, Yoshitsune with Hassou Tobi, Yukiko with Amrita and Mediarahan. Dis-Fear / Sedative items.

bosses.name: Ameno-sagiri
bosses.strategy: 1) 'Fog of Confusion': Ameno-sagiri envelops the arena in dense fog making him 100% IMMUNE TO ALL DAMAGE for 3 turns. DO NOT ATTACK while the fog is active; use these turns to cast Heat Riser, Matarukaja, Charge, and heal to full HP! 2) 'God's Judgment' and 'Quake': When the fog clears, he unleashes devastating Almighty and physical attacks. Have your party GUARD when he charges, then burst him down with Power Charged Hassou Tobi or Primal Force.
bosses.buildPrep: Yoshitsune with Hassou Tobi and Power Charge. Trumpeter with Debilitate and Heat Riser. Yukiko with Mediarahan.

bosses.name: Izanami
bosses.strategy: Phase 1: Izanami uses Megidolaon, Mabufudyne, and Magarudyne. When her HP reaches 0, she will enter an invulnerable state where your attacks do 0 damage. Continue to GUARD AND ATTACK for 3 turns until the story sequence triggers, revealing her true form: Izanami-no-Okami!
bosses.buildPrep: Party Level 80+. Third Awakening skills unlocked (Youthful Wind for Yosuke, Burning Petals for Yukiko, Dragon Hustle for Chie). Personas with Debilitate and Mind Charge.

bosses.name: Izanami-no-Okami (True Final Boss)
bosses.resistances: Nulls Light/Dark, High Defense against all damage
bosses.strategy: The True Final Boss! 1) 'Yomi no Kegare': Inflicts Fouled status on a party member; if hit with 'Gallows' while Fouled, they are instantly KO'd. Immediately cure Fouled with Amrita/Salvation. 2) 'Fury of Yasoshima': Charges twice and attacks twice per turn with severe elemental dynes and Megidolaon. 3) 'Thousand Curses': When her HP drops to zero, she attempts to drag party members into the underworld. Survive the scripted cutscene, witness Izanagi evolve into Izanagi-no-Okami, and execute 'MYRIAD TRUTHS' for the final victory!
bosses.buildPrep: Yoshitsune with Hassou Tobi + Power Charge + Apt Pupil. Trumpeter with Debilitate. Yukiko with Salvation and Mediarahan. Stock 5+ Homunculus items.

bosses.name: The Reaper (P4G / P4)
bosses.location: Any dungeon chest after hearing rattling chains (21st/22nd chest)
bosses.resistances: Light/Dark (Null), Immune to all status ailments
bosses.strategy:
How to Spawn: Open 20-21 standard chests until you hear heavy chains rattling. Go to a floor with 2 normal chests (like Yukiko's Castle 5F), open a normal chest, and select 'Yes' when warned of a terrifying presence.

Fight Strategy: The Reaper acts TWICE per turn and uses all four Break skills (Fire/Ice/Elec/Wind Break) followed by severe Ma-dyne spells, Mind Charge -> Megidolaon, Vorpal Blade, Mahamaon, and Mamudoon.
1) DO NOT USE MAKRAKARN OR MAGIC MIRRORS: Doing so causes The Reaper to spam 999-damage Megidolaon every single turn!
2) Keep DEBILITATE on The Reaper at all times (cuts his attack, defense, and hit rate).
3) Keep Matarukaja and Marakukaja active on the party.
4) Guard on turns after he casts Mind Charge.
5) Use Yoshitsune's Power Charged 'Hassou Tobi' as your primary damage dealer.

Rewards: First kill drops the ultimate weapon for Yu (Blade of Totsuka). Subsequent kills drop ultimate weapons for current active party members, followed by Godly Robes and the Omnipotent Orb.
bosses.buildPrep: Recommended Level 75-85+. Yoshitsune with Hassou Tobi, Power Charge, Enduring Soul, and Apt Pupil. Trumpeter with Debilitate. Stock 5+ Homunculus items to protect against instant-death spells.

bosses.name: Margaret (Ultimate Superboss)
bosses.strategy:
Requirements: New Game+ only, Rank 10 Empress Social Link, all optional dungeon bosses defeated before March 20th. Obtain Orb of Truth on 3/20, visit Velvet Room to receive Aqua Invitation, and head to Heaven 10F.

Battle Mechanics:
1) ATTACKS TWICE PER TURN.
2) 50-TURN ENRAGE TIMER: If the battle exceeds 50 turns, Margaret casts an unavoidable 9999 Megidolaon wipe!
3) DO NOT EQUIP OMNIPOTENT ORB: Equipping it triggers an instant 9999 Megidolaon on turn 1.
4) Elemental Rotation: Cycles Fire (Siegfried) -> Ice (Loki) -> Elec (Cu Chulainn) -> Wind (Helel) -> Mind Charge -> Megidolaon. Absorb/Drain the element she is currently using.
5) Keep Debilitate on Margaret constantly and maintain Marakukaja/Matarukaja.
6) Have Yukiko cast Mediarahan/Salvation EVERY TURN while Yu dishes out Power Charged Hassou Tobi.
bosses.buildPrep: Recommended Level 95-99. Yoshitsune with Hassou Tobi, Power Charge, Enduring Soul, and Arms Master. Trumpeter with Debilitate and Heat Riser. Yukiko with Salvation and Spell Master.

bosses.name: Kusumi-no-Okami (Marie's Hollow Forest Boss)
bosses.resistances: Repels all Physical and Elemental damage (except Almighty) until Breakers are used
bosses.strategy:
How to Access: Max Marie's Aeon Social Link (Rank 10) before 12/23 and speak to Margaret on 1/2 in the Velvet Room to unlock the Hollow Forest dungeon on 2/13.

Battle Mechanics:
1) Stage 1 (Marie): Guard for 3 turns until the battle ends via cutscene.
2) Stage 2 (Kusumi-no-Okami): Your party's SP is immediately halved upon starting!
3) She naturally REPELS ALL PHYSICAL AND MAGIC attacks. You MUST use 'Breaker' items (Fire Break, Ice Break, Wind Break items found in Hollow Forest chests) or cast Break spells to strip her immunity for 3 turns, then burst her down with that specific element!
4) Use 'Magatama' and restorative combs collected throughout the dungeon to restore SP.
bosses.buildPrep: Stockpile 10+ Breaker items and restorative combs from Hollow Forest chests. Equip Personas with Mediarahan, Power Charge, and Almighty skills (Megidolaon).

bosses.name: Yosuke's Shadow
bosses.strategy: The tutorial boss fight of the game. Yosuke's Shadow uses Power Charge followed by Wind of Vanity and physical attacks. Hit him with Izanagi's Zio to knock him down and gain '1 More'. Guard immediately on the turn after he uses Power Charge to block his amplified attack.
bosses.buildPrep: Izanagi equipped with Zio. Keep Medicine on hand to heal if your HP drops below half.

bosses.name: Chie's Shadow
bosses.strategy: Chie's Shadow uses Mabsent Mind to cause dizziness and targets Yosuke with Green Wall and Bufu (which hits Yosuke's weakness!). Use Yosuke's Garu to knock her down and trigger All-Out Attacks. When she uses 'Bottomless Gaze' (locking onto Yosuke), have Yosuke Guard to prevent her from exploiting his Ice weakness.
bosses.buildPrep: Persona with Garu or physical skills. Yosuke equipped with Garu. Stock 4-5 Medicines.

bosses.name: Avenger Knight (Mini-Boss)
bosses.strategy: Avenger Knight buffs himself with Power Charge and delivers heavy physical strikes. He is weak to Fire; however, avoid using Chie's physical attacks as he resists them. Use Fire spells or items to knock him down for All-Out Attacks.
bosses.buildPrep: Persona with Agi (Senri, Orobas). Chie and Yosuke on support/healing duty.

bosses.name: Yukiko's Shadow
bosses.strategy: Yukiko's Shadow casts Burn to Ash (heavy fire damage) and White Wall (boosts ice defense). When she summons the 'Charming Prince', focus fire on the Prince immediately because he heals her with Dia and casts White Wall. When she uses 'Shivering Glance' (locking onto Chie), HAVE CHIE GUARD IMMEDIATELY to prevent her from being knocked down by Agilao.
bosses.buildPrep: Fusing Senri (Null Fire) is the MVP strategy for Yu, making you immune to Burn to Ash. Chie equipped with Bufu/Mabufu. Stock 5+ Ice Cubes or Revival Beads.

bosses.name: Contrarian King (Optional Dungeon Boss)
bosses.strategy: One of the most dangerous optional bosses in the early game! He opens with Rampage (dealing devastating physical strike damage that can wipe a party under level 30). You MUST cast Tarunda to lower his attack, Marakukaja to boost party defense, and have party members Guard if their HP is below 70%. Deal damage using Elec (Zio) or Ice (Bufu).
bosses.buildPrep: Recommended Level 32-35+. Personas with high Endurance and Physical Resist (Eligor, Rakshasa). Equip Red Wall on Chie.

bosses.name: Daring Gigas (Mini-Boss)
bosses.strategy: Spams Power Charge, Tarukaja, and Single Shot. Have Yukiko or Yu lower his attack with Tarunda. Guard on the turn after Power Charge to absorb his huge strike.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Tarunda, Media, and Physical resistance (Archangel, Ares).

bosses.name: Shadow Kanji, Nice Guy & Tough Guy
bosses.weaknesses: Nice Guy: Ice (Weak), Fire (Weak) | Tough Guy: Fire (Weak) | Shadow Kanji: None
bosses.strategy: Kill Order: 1) NICE GUY FIRST (He casts Heat Riser, Diarama, and Tetrakarn on Shadow Kanji). 2) TOUGH GUY SECOND (Uses Rampage and Sonic Punch). 3) SHADOW KANJI LAST. When Shadow Kanji casts 'Forbidden Murmur' (inflicts Poison on males) or 'Roar of Wrath' (inflicts Rage on females), cure ailments immediately. When he uses 'Fanatical Spark' (charges electricity), have Yosuke Guard to protect his Elec weakness.
bosses.buildPrep: Persona with Bufu/Agi (Jack Frost, Hua Po, King Frost). Dokudami Tea / Dis-Poison items. Keep Yukiko on constant Mediarama healing.

bosses.name: Intolerant Officer (Optional Dungeon Boss)
bosses.strategy: Summons backup and uses Poison Mist + Vicious Strike. Exploit its Elec weakness using Kanji or Yu's Zio to keep him pinned down.
bosses.buildPrep: Persona with Zionga/Mazionga and Elec Boost (Take-Mikazuchi, Thoth).

bosses.name: Amorous Snake (Mini-Boss)
bosses.strategy: Uses Stagnant Air, Poison Mist, and Virus Wave. Hit her with Yukiko's Agilao or Yu's Fire spells to trigger All-Out Attacks.
bosses.buildPrep: Dis-Poison and Persona with Fire skills (Hua Po, Pyro Jack).

bosses.name: Rise's Shadow
bosses.resistances: Shifts affinities each turn via Analysis
bosses.strategy: Phase 1: Rise attacks with all four elemental spells. When her HP reaches 50%, she uses 'Supreme Analysis' making all attacks miss. Simply GUARD FOR 3 TURNS until the cutscene triggers; this ends the fight and transitions into Shadow Teddie!
bosses.buildPrep: Personas covering multiple elements without severe weaknesses. Keep Mediarama ready.

bosses.name: Shadow Teddie
bosses.strategy: Shadow Teddie attacks twice per turn and casts Mind Charge, Mabufula, and Heat Wave. Watch out for two key telegraphs: 1) 'Ultra Charge' (charges glowing orb): You have 1 turn to hit him, then EVERY PARTY MEMBER MUST GUARD on the next turn to survive 'Nihil Hand' (massive Almighty damage). 2) 'Nullity Curl' (inflicts Dizzy on entire party): Immediately cure dizzy allies before Nihil Hand hits.
bosses.buildPrep: Fusing Dis or King Frost with Media and Energy Drop. Keep Yukiko on constant heal duty and Kanji for physical burst.

bosses.name: Momentary Child (Optional Dungeon Boss)
bosses.strategy: Uses Rampage, Deathbound, and Tarukaja. Hit with Ice spells (Bufudyne) to knock down and execute All-Out Attacks.
bosses.buildPrep: Persona with Bufudyne / Ice Amp (King Frost, Ganga).

bosses.name: Killing Hand (Mini-Boss)
bosses.strategy: Summons Almighty Hands. Focus fire on the Killing Hand first to stop it from repeatedly summoning reinforcements.
bosses.buildPrep: Persona with Deathbound or multi-target elemental spells.

bosses.name: Shadow Mitsuo / Mitsuo the Hero
bosses.strategy: Two-Phase Boss Fight: 1) 'Mitsuo the Hero' (8-bit outer shell): Attack with heavy physicals and magic. When the shell breaks, Shadow Mitsuo is exposed. 2) 'Shadow Mitsuo' Core: Unload your highest damage skills (Black Frost's Mind Charge + Agidyne, Kanji's Fatal End) while he is knocked down. When he starts chanting to rebuild the shell ('Whisper' -> 'Chant' -> 'Prayer'), deal enough damage to interrupt the chant and stun him again! Beware: When he inflicts Fear, CURE IT IMMEDIATELY or he will cast 'Ghastly Wail' for an instant wipe!
bosses.buildPrep: MVP Persona: Black Frost (has Mind Charge, Agidyne, Fire Amp, and no elemental weaknesses). Stock 10+ Sedative / Dis-Fear items. Keep Mediarama active every turn.

bosses.name: Escapist Soldier (Optional Dungeon Boss)
bosses.strategy: Uses Mudoon and heavy strike skills with High Counter. DO NOT use physical attacks! Spam Garudyne / Magarula with Yosuke to knock him down.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Garudyne and Wind Amp (Garuda, Kurama Tengu).

bosses.name: Dominating Machine (Optional Dungeon Boss)
bosses.strategy: Spams Power Charge + God's Hand and Gigantic Fist. Keep Tarunda and Marakukaja active and blast with severe elemental magic.
bosses.buildPrep: Trumpeter or Black Frost with Rakunda, Tarunda, and Ziodyne.

bosses.name: Shadow Naoto
bosses.strategy: Shadow Naoto casts 'Element Zero' (removes all party elemental resistances), followed by single-target -dyne spells targeting weaknesses. She uses 'Mute Ray' (inflicts Silence) and 'Galgalim Eyes' (reduces a party member's HP to 1 and inflicts Enervation!). When Galgalim Eyes lands, immediately heal the afflicted party member with Diarahan/Medicine. Buff party defense and hit with heavy physical or almighty spells.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Mediarahan, Energy Shower, and Amrita Soda items. High physical attackers like Kanji (Primal Force).

bosses.name: Kunino-Sagiri
bosses.strategy: 1) Quad Converge: Amplifies ONE element by 300% and reduces all other damage to single digits. Identify the boosted element (by watching which spell he casts) and hit him with that exact element! 2) Control Mechanism: At 50% HP, he MIND CONTROLS 1 to 3 of your party members to fight for him! DO NOT ATTACK YOUR ALLIES; simply have Yu GUARD and cast Mediarahan until the mind control wears off after 3 turns. 3) Usubeni no Mai: Deals heavy Almighty damage, guard when his HP is low.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with all 4 high-tier elements (Ziodyne, Agidyne, Garudyne, Bufudyne), Mediarahan, and Debilitate (Trumpeter).

bosses.name: Taro Namatame
bosses.resistances: Shifts affinities based on active avatars
bosses.strategy: Namatame manifests avatars of light and darkness. Use Rakunda on him and cycle between physical and magic damage. Keep party HP above 80% to avoid sudden burst downs.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Mediarahan, Matarukaja, and Marakukaja.

bosses.name: Tohru Adachi
bosses.strategy: Adachi uses Evil Smile (Fear) -> Ghastly Wail (Instant Death combo), Heat Riser, Ziodyne, and Mudoon. Keep Dekaja ready to immediately strip his Heat Riser buffs! Equip Null Fear accessories on your party. Use Debilitate on Adachi and blast him with Hassou Tobi or severe spells. When Adachi's HP drops to 0, the battle immediately transitions into Ameno-sagiri with NO rest!
bosses.buildPrep: Trumpeter with Debilitate, Yoshitsune with Hassou Tobi, Yukiko with Amrita and Mediarahan. Dis-Fear / Sedative items.

bosses.name: Ameno-sagiri
bosses.strategy: 1) 'Fog of Confusion': Ameno-sagiri envelops the arena in dense fog making him 100% IMMUNE TO ALL DAMAGE for 3 turns. DO NOT ATTACK while the fog is active; use these turns to cast Heat Riser, Matarukaja, Charge, and heal to full HP! 2) 'God's Judgment' and 'Quake': When the fog clears, he unleashes devastating Almighty and physical attacks. Have your party GUARD when he charges, then burst him down with Power Charged Hassou Tobi or Primal Force.
bosses.buildPrep: Yoshitsune with Hassou Tobi and Power Charge. Trumpeter with Debilitate and Heat Riser. Yukiko with Mediarahan.

bosses.name: Izanami
bosses.strategy: Phase 1: Izanami uses Megidolaon, Mabufudyne, and Magarudyne. When her HP reaches 0, she will enter an invulnerable state where your attacks do 0 damage. Continue to GUARD AND ATTACK for 3 turns until the story sequence triggers, revealing her true form: Izanami-no-Okami!
bosses.buildPrep: Party Level 80+. Third Awakening skills unlocked (Youthful Wind for Yosuke, Burning Petals for Yukiko, Dragon Hustle for Chie). Personas with Debilitate and Mind Charge.

bosses.name: Izanami-no-Okami (True Final Boss)
bosses.resistances: Nulls Light/Dark, High Defense against all damage
bosses.strategy: The True Final Boss! 1) 'Yomi no Kegare': Inflicts Fouled status on a party member; if hit with 'Gallows' while Fouled, they are instantly KO'd. Immediately cure Fouled with Amrita/Salvation. 2) 'Fury of Yasoshima': Charges twice and attacks twice per turn with severe elemental dynes and Megidolaon. 3) 'Thousand Curses': When her HP drops to zero, she attempts to drag party members into the underworld. Survive the scripted cutscene, witness Izanagi evolve into Izanagi-no-Okami, and execute 'MYRIAD TRUTHS' for the final victory!
bosses.buildPrep: Yoshitsune with Hassou Tobi + Power Charge + Apt Pupil. Trumpeter with Debilitate. Yukiko with Salvation and Mediarahan. Stock 5+ Homunculus items.

bosses.name: The Reaper (P4G / P4)
bosses.location: Any dungeon chest after hearing rattling chains (21st/22nd chest)
bosses.resistances: Light/Dark (Null), Immune to all status ailments
bosses.strategy:
How to Spawn: Open 20-21 standard chests until you hear heavy chains rattling. Go to a floor with 2 normal chests (like Yukiko's Castle 5F), open a normal chest, and select 'Yes' when warned of a terrifying presence.

Fight Strategy: The Reaper acts TWICE per turn and uses all four Break skills (Fire/Ice/Elec/Wind Break) followed by severe Ma-dyne spells, Mind Charge -> Megidolaon, Vorpal Blade, Mahamaon, and Mamudoon.
1) DO NOT USE MAKRAKARN OR MAGIC MIRRORS: Doing so causes The Reaper to spam 999-damage Megidolaon every single turn!
2) Keep DEBILITATE on The Reaper at all times (cuts his attack, defense, and hit rate).
3) Keep Matarukaja and Marakukaja active on the party.
4) Guard on turns after he casts Mind Charge.
5) Use Yoshitsune's Power Charged 'Hassou Tobi' as your primary damage dealer.

Rewards: First kill drops the ultimate weapon for Yu (Blade of Totsuka). Subsequent kills drop ultimate weapons for current active party members, followed by Godly Robes and the Omnipotent Orb.
bosses.buildPrep: Recommended Level 75-85+. Yoshitsune with Hassou Tobi, Power Charge, Enduring Soul, and Apt Pupil. Trumpeter with Debilitate. Stock 5+ Homunculus items to protect against instant-death spells.

bosses.name: Margaret (Ultimate Superboss)
bosses.strategy:
Requirements: New Game+ only, Rank 10 Empress Social Link, all optional dungeon bosses defeated before March 20th. Obtain Orb of Truth on 3/20, visit Velvet Room to receive Aqua Invitation, and head to Heaven 10F.

Battle Mechanics:
1) ATTACKS TWICE PER TURN.
2) 50-TURN ENRAGE TIMER: If the battle exceeds 50 turns, Margaret casts an unavoidable 9999 Megidolaon wipe!
3) DO NOT EQUIP OMNIPOTENT ORB: Equipping it triggers an instant 9999 Megidolaon on turn 1.
4) Elemental Rotation: Cycles Fire (Siegfried) -> Ice (Loki) -> Elec (Cu Chulainn) -> Wind (Helel) -> Mind Charge -> Megidolaon. Absorb/Drain the element she is currently using.
5) Keep Debilitate on Margaret constantly and maintain Marakukaja/Matarukaja.
6) Have Yukiko cast Mediarahan/Salvation EVERY TURN while Yu dishes out Power Charged Hassou Tobi.
bosses.buildPrep: Recommended Level 95-99. Yoshitsune with Hassou Tobi, Power Charge, Enduring Soul, and Arms Master. Trumpeter with Debilitate and Heat Riser. Yukiko with Salvation and Spell Master.

bosses.name: Shadow Kamoshida (Asmodeus / Captain Kamoshida)
bosses.strategy: In Phase 1, attack Kamoshida while Morgana heals. When he drinks from the Trophy of Obsession to heal, target and destroy the Trophy first! In Phase 2, send a teammate (e.g. Ryuji or Morgana) on a Special Assignment to steal the Crown while keeping Kamoshida distracted with regular attacks.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Tarunda (decrease his attack), Dia/Media, and physical skills like Lunge/Cleave. Stock up on Medicine.

bosses.name: Shadow Madarame (Azazel) & False Artworks
bosses.weaknesses: Eyes/Nose/Mouth: Each absorbs specific elements and is weak to others
bosses.strategy: Phase 1 consists of 4 painting parts: Right Eye (Weak to Physical, Drains Magic), Left Eye (Weak to Physical, Drains Magic), Nose (Weak to Magic, Absorbs Physical), Mouth (Weak to Magic, Absorbs Physical). Use multi-target physicals like Yusuke's Vicious Strike and single-target magic on the Mouth/Nose. When the True Madarame emerges, clone himself and attack with severe elemental skills.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas covering all 4 core elements plus Rampage or Swift Strike (Shiisaa, Matador, Eligor). Bring Black Paint if available.

bosses.name: Shadow Kaneshiro (Bael) & Piggytron
bosses.strategy: Kaneshiro summons Piggytron, a giant armored mech. When Piggytron begins spinning for 'March of the Piggy' (massive party damage), either have all party members Guard or throw an expensive valuable item (e.g. Gold Bar, Ring) to distract him! Exploit Makoto's Frei skills on his summoned Hitmen.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Frei/Nuclear skills (Makami, Shiisaa) and defense buffs (Rakukaja). Bring expensive loot items to bribe Piggytron.

bosses.name: Cognitive Wakaba Isshiki (Sphinx)
bosses.strategy: Wakaba flies high and dive-bombs the party for severe physical damage. Use the Ballista special assignment to shoot her down from the air! Once grounded, she takes massive increased damage from all physical and elemental attacks. Have Morgana or Makoto cast Media/Mediarama every turn.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Wind/Garu or Nuclear/Frei, Tarunda, and physical resistance (Arahabaki, Shiki-Ouji).

bosses.name: Shadow Okumura (Mammon) & Corporate Waves
bosses.weaknesses: Wave 1 (Blue): Fire/Wind | Wave 2 (Yellow): Psy/Ice | Wave 3 (Red): Elec/Nuclear | Wave 4 (Blue Corp): Wind/Bless | Wave 5 (Green Execs): Psy/Curse
bosses.strategy: The most notorious battle in P5R! You have a strict 30-minute timer and each wave of 4 robots MUST BE DEFEATED SIMULTANEOUSLY in 2 turns, or the survivors will flee and reset the wave at full HP! Use single-target elemental items or spells to chain 4-stage Baton Passes to Joker/Haru, then finish with max-power multi-target spells (Mapsiodyne, Magarudyne).
bosses.buildPrep: Stock 5+ elemental damage items for every element. Set difficulty to Merciless (deals 3x weakness damage, making the DPS check easier!). Fuse Personas with Psy, Curse, and Wind boosts (Red Rider, Hariti, Daisoujou).

bosses.name: Shadow Sae (Leviathan / Sae Niijima)
bosses.strategy: Phase 1 is the Roulette Game: DO NOT ATTACK during the wager or you will be penalized 1 HP! Pick the safest bet and send a sniper teammate to glass the roulette wheel. In Phase 2, Sae transforms into Berserker Leviathan, using Severe elemental attacks and Hundred Fists. Keep Defense buffs up and burst her down.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Dekaja (to dispel her Tarukaja) and Tarunda. Bring Revival Beads and Mediarama.

bosses.name: Shadow Shido (Samael) & Beast of Human Sacrifice
bosses.resistances: Shifts forms (Winged Beast, Tomb of Human Sacrifice, True Form)
bosses.strategy: A 5-phase marathon! 1) Winged Beast: Resists physical, use magic. 2) Tomb of Human Sacrifice: Resists magic, use physical/Gun. 3) Pyramid Beast: Uses Tyrant's Glare, guard when charging. 4) True Shido: Debuffs entire party and strikes twice per turn. 5) 1-on-1 Duel Phase: Maintain Tarunda on Shido and unload your highest damage combos (Charge + God's Hand, Concentrate + Megidolaon).
bosses.buildPrep: Trumpeter with Debilitate, Charge, Concentrate, and Salvation. Ryuji with Matarukaja and Charge.

bosses.name: Holy Grail & Depths of Mementos
bosses.strategy: In the first encounter, the Grail cannot be defeated (story scripted). In the second encounter, the Grail heals itself by siphoning human desire through veins. Send a teammate to sever the supply lines while the rest of the party attacks the Grail. Guard when it charges 'Will of the People' (Arrow of Light).
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with high endurance and Mediarahan (Cybele, Kohryu, Baal).

bosses.name: Yaldabaoth (God of Control)
bosses.resistances: Each of the 4 Arms reflects/absorbs different elements
bosses.strategy: Yaldabaoth manifests 4 Arms representing the Deadly Sins: Gun of Execution, Bell of Declaration, Sword of Conviction, Book of Commandments. Destroy the arms quickly because they grant Yaldabaoth extra actions and ailments. When he begins charging 'Rays of Control' (Divine Apex), destroy all arms and Guard immediately to survive the Almighty blast.
bosses.buildPrep: Yoshitsune with Hassou Tobi, Trumpeter with Debilitate, Satan / Lucifer with Megidolaon, Salvation.

bosses.name: Caroline & Justine (The Twins Superboss)
bosses.resistances: High Stats, Attacks 6 times combined per turn
bosses.strategy: The Twins attack with all severe elemental spells and technical combos. You MUST deal at least 2,500 damage every 5 turns or they will knock your entire party down with an All-Out Attack wipe! Both Twins MUST be defeated within the same turn or the survivor will cast Recarm on the other with half HP.
bosses.buildPrep: Yoshitsune (Hassou Tobi + Charge), Debilitate, Thermopylae, and Salvation.

bosses.name: The Reaper
bosses.location: Mementos (Stand idle on any floor for 2 minutes)
bosses.strategy: In P5R, let the Reaper ambush YOU (so he gets only 1 action per turn instead of 2!). Cast Debilitate on him, maintain Marakukaja and Matarukaja, and pound him with Concentrate + Megidolaon or Hassou Tobi.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with Null Bless/Curse to avoid Hamaon/Mudoon, Concentrate, Charge, and Debilitate.

bosses.name: Dr. Takuto Maruki, Azathoth & Adam Kadmon
bosses.location: Maruki's Palace - Garden of Eden (3rd Semester Final Boss)
bosses.weaknesses: Tendrils: Weak to specific elements | Azathoth: None
bosses.resistances: Maruki is shielded until Azathoth / Tendrils are damaged
bosses.strategy: Phase 1: Maruki restricts specific actions each turn (e.g. No Healing, No Baton Pass, No Magic). Exploit the Tendrils' weaknesses to Baton Pass to Joker for max damage on Azathoth. Phase 2: Azathoth uses True Barrier and severe Almighty. Burst down Azathoth. Phase 3: Maruki summons gigantic Adam Kadmon. Survive Adam Kadmon's giant swings, keep shields up, and land the final strike to break his crown.
bosses.buildPrep: Izanagi-no-Okami Picaro (Myriad Truths), Yoshitsune, Maria with Holy Benevolence, and Debilitate.

bosses.name: Lavenza (3rd Semester Ultimate Superboss)
bosses.location: Mementos Depths (NG+ 3rd Semester Velvet Room Challenge)
bosses.resistances: Must fulfill phase DPS and gimmick checks
bosses.strategy: 4 Strict Phases: Phase 1: Deal 5,000 damage with opposing elements (Fire vs Ice, Elec vs Wind). Phase 2: Land a Technical hit EVERY SINGLE TURN (Inflict Sleep/Dizzy then strike). Phase 3: Land a Critical hit EVERY SINGLE TURN (Sumire with Brave Step + Apt Pupil Sword Dance). Phase 4: Full DPS race before she casts Megidolaon for 9,999 wipe.
bosses.buildPrep: Izanagi-no-Okami Picaro, Yoshitsune, Personas with high Crit rate, Sleep Vial items, and Salvation.

bosses.name: Jose (Mementos Superboss)
bosses.strategy: Jose drives his star buggy across the battlefield dealing heavy physical and Almighty damage, tossing colorful firecrackers that inflict random ailments. Buff party defense and hit him with Concentrate + severe magic or Hassou Tobi.
bosses.buildPrep: Personas with high physical resistance and Mediarahan.
